# Instruction wording fixtures

These synthetic development examples cover capability and reader-intention
introductions, an adjacent method announcement, and a redundant location
predicate. Controls retain failure possibilities, real capability limits,
quoted wording and protected code. The CLI applies BOM and CRLF and checks
source ranges in Markdown, a Go comment and a Go string.

The policy forbids these constructions explicitly to test exit behavior.
Built-in profiles keep the new diagnostics as experimental warnings.
